title: IK Target Classifier
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Robot Kinematics
description: Move a target around a two-link arm and see the ring of positions the tip can reach, with the elbow-up and elbow-down arms that reach it. Then classify eight targets as having two solutions, one solution, or being too far or too close to reach. Used in Chapter 12.

educational.topic: Inverse kinematics of a two-link arm: multiple solutions and unreachable targets
learningObjectives: Differentiate eight targets for a two-link arm (l1 = 0.116 m, l2 = 0.135 m) as having two solutions, one solution, or being unreachable too far or too close, with at least 7 of 8 correct on the first attempt

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Explore the reachable ring by moving a target, then classify targets by their distance from the shoulder
keyQuestions: Why can a target inside the outer circle still be out of reach?
Where does a target have exactly one solution?
commonMisconceptions: Every target inside the outer circle can be reached
Every reachable target has exactly one solution
The elbow can be placed anywhere
assessmentOpportunities: Eight committed classifications, one attempt each; 7 of 8 for mastery

controls.label: Drag or tap the target on the plot
Two solutions / One solution / Too far to reach / Too close to reach
Next target / See score / Try again
